reviews.title: Perfect for photo storage
reviews.comment: Came with hard drives installed, setup was easy and fast. we use this for photo storage so this unit has ample storage space with plenty of features. The Synology Photo app makes uploading photos simple efficient. The desktop app makes creating folders for each job fast and easy. Overall very happy with the functionality and value of this unit.
reviews.author: SNC Construction

reviews.title: Must purchase for electronic storage
reviews.comment: Great to store all photos and videos
reviews.author: Michael Fisher

reviews.title: I think it's great!!
reviews.comment: I don't know why I didn't do this sooner! This is by far one of my most favorite investments. Though I'm an IT guy and it took me a short while to figure everything out, it was definitely fun to incorporate into my home network. Just get it. It's a great addition.
reviews.author: B Jeff

reviews.title: Don't Buy This buy one with 4 or 5 Bays
reviews.comment: This is the second one I've ordered and only 1 drive appeared.  They were BOTH broken so I would say that this product is terrible.  Feel free to purchase ANYTHING ELSE and I'm sure you will do better than buying this one.  Get a 4 or 5 bay in the future to avoid this problem.
reviews.author: Laura Eisenberg
